title: Festive Haloumi and Chickpea Salad
subtitle: with Herb Stuffing Crumbs
description: After a fast, festive vegetarian feast? Look no further! Sprinkle zesty thyme-flecked 'stuffing' crumbs over pan-fried haloumi, chickpeas and veggies for a delicious celebration on a plate.

steps.text: Prep vegetables: Peel the carrots, then peel into ribbons with a vegetable peeler. Trim the beans and halve lengthwise (see Make it faster). Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Chop half the thyme leaves, discarding the stems. Finely grate the zest of half the lemon, then juice the half.

Cook beans: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the beans. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Put the lemon juice, 1½ tbs olive oil and 2 tsp honey in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Cook the beans in the pan of boiling water for 1-2 mins until tender. Drain, then rinse under cold water to cool.

Toast stuffing crumbs: Meanwhile, melt 15g butter in a medium frypan over medium heat. Add the garlic, thyme and lemon zest and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant. Add the breadcrumbs and cook, stirring, for 3 mins or until golden. Remove from the pan. Wipe the pan clean with paper towel.
Cook haloumi: Thinly slice the haloumi. Spray or brush the frypan with olive oil and heat over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Add the carrot, beans and chickpeas to the dressing and toss gently to combine. Divide the salad among plates. Top with the haloumi and scatter over the stuffing crumbs. Enjoy!
Make it faster: Save time by cutting the green beans into thirds instead of lengthwise, and grating the carrots with a box grater. It won't be as pretty, but it will be just as delicious!
